text:
sam: heads-up 10 — two customers asked for clearer reasons when requests hit fallbacks. proposal: expose a tiny, stable reason token + a short human hint in the error payload and a lightweight header. thoughts?
elaine: ok if we keep tokens generic (e.g., ROUTE_CONGESTION) and the hint free-text but scrubbed. no placement IDs or topology names in payloads.
mike: agreed. SDKs prefer a header so they can fast-path retry logic without JSON parsing. suggestion: `x-rwinf-retryable` + `x-rwinf-reason`. body still authoritative.
jordan: from ops/telemetry: we need a metric dimension for the reason to triage. high-cardinality is a risk; I propose a sampled dimension with a bounded enum of reasons we support. add `fallback_hops` as a numeric tag.
irene: please add privacy constraints: hints must be sanitized, examples redacted, and a denylist of tenant-like strings. telemetry labels must never include tenant ids.
paola: console UX: show aggregated reason counts per customer. let ops click-through to sanitized examples and set alerts on new reason tokens. show a short suggested action in-console (e.g., "try async", "increase concurrency quota").
sam: example payload sketch (minimal):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ROUTE_CONGESTION",
    "message": "Traffic is elevated; request routed to a lower-latency fallback. Try again or use async mode.",
    "attrs": {"fallback_hops": "2"}
  }
}
```
Note: no route ids, no placement info.
elaine: minor ask: include a stable machine-readable code (code) and keep message for end users. we can support `suggested_action` in SDKs, but not in public payload initially.
mike: rollout plan: behind flag `expose_routing_reason`. start internal only -> selected customers opt-in -> GA. telemetry sampling default 0.5% for new codes for first 2 weeks.
jordan: also add an internal-only tag `raw_route_key` in logs (not exported to metrics or payloads) so SRE can tie samples back to placement safely. logs must be access-controlled.
irene: runbook addition: if a bad leak is spotted, feature flag should be revocable immediately and there's an incident checklist to scrub caches. we need automated scans that verify no tenant-like tokens appear in exported hints.
paola: console mockups incoming: top-line card, breakdown by reason, quick action buttons (open support, request quota review). ops-only view shows sampled raw lines with redact toggle.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: feature-flag flip on staging: 2024-07-01T03:00Z, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% across customers opting in.
sam: open items:
- jordan: RFC for payload + metrics + log gating (due Wed)
- paola: console flows and mockups (due Fri)
- mike: SDK behavior doc + header parser test (PR next week)
- irene: privacy checklist + scrubber rules (ASAP)
- elaine: header names + API docs draft (PT)
